cases: 5+ successful tool calls are worth reflecting and yield a candidate
a 2-step simple query is not worth reflecting and returns no candidates
failure recovery and cross-agent evidence are both reflected
thresholds come from config, not from the agent loop
reflection is read-only, tenant-scoped and refuses an agent mismatch

limits: cross-agent detection in v2.5.5 uses im2a_send/im2a_recv bus spans, not peer-agent attribution
candidates are suggestions; no skill/memory/proposal/trace writes are performed
